entries.message: This update includes restore library loading and navigation behavior, keep dashboard live across browsers and polish mobile Up Next, and match opened poster width to the folded poster on phones.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep desktop navigation and library controls visible without empty action space.
Add Movies and TV Shows tabs with Year and Genre filters to cast filmographies.
Center mobile cast profiles and open TV library cards with details beside their posters.
Show loading progress while library pages fetch and preserve distinct titles that share poster artwork.
Keep first-page library cache visible while it refreshes after history changes, and discard stale later pages.
Harden server error responses and update undici to address upstream security advisories.
Recently Watched refreshes on live history events without waiting for provider sync.
Up Next reads the shared server snapshot on every dashboard visit, so the first paint no longer shows a stale browser-local copy.
Clearing progress or removing an item from Up Next updates other devices and open dashboards.
Open dashboard windows in the same browser share one live stream, so queue changes appear in all of them.
Phone featured Up Next cards are taller and wider with larger posters, and their scrollbar stays visible.
The duplicate Up Next title on phones becomes a compact toolbar for queue actions.
Opened posters on Watchlist and Ratings keep the folded poster's width on phones instead of shrinking by about 10px, and opened Watch history cards keep the folded poster's size too.
Discover and Playlists phone rows and the timeline live panel get the related phone layout tweaks in the same stylesheet.
messageFragments: Fix - Restore library loading and navigation behavior
Fix - Keep dashboard live across browsers and polish mobile Up Next
Fix - Match opened poster width to the folded poster on phones
